mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.2% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger risk-off sentiment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% in one month indicate weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 105 (2017=100) indicates sustained economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO > 105.

mechanism_narrative: Consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 228.5 signals inflationary pressure that prompts central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 228.5.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent industrial production decline (>0.5%) and unemployment rate increase (>0.2%) in one month indicate economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO declines > 0.5% and UNRATE rises > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both INDPRO declines > 0.5% and UNRATE rises > 0.2% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 700.0 thousand units indicates strong construction activity and consumer confidence, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST > 700.0.

mechanism_narrative: Total non-farm payrolls below 134.0 million persons signals labor market contraction, reducing consumer spending and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS < 134000.
